name: Doodle, Please!
summary: Doodle, Please! is a hand-drawn physics puzzle game in which the player draws on a notebook page to guide a stick figure to a flag. An open stroke can form a bridge or a rope, and a closed shape becomes a stone. Across six islands, the player uses counterweights, water and wind to move platforms and other objects.
